content.short: Huffmate is a growing collection of modern extensible Huff language smart contracts.
content.description: Audited Huff contracts form an experimental library that demonstrates the language's capabilities in practical use. Developers can leverage these contracts for authentication, data structures, and proxies, as well as for Huff cloning, auctions, math operations, token creation and transfers, and a range of other utility use cases. The collection supports experimentation and iteration, offering reusable components and patterns that illustrate how Huff can be applied across common smart contract tasks.
